visual_logic.composition: A wide view of the forest floor. A dense, 'shag carpet' of clubmosses rolls over fallen logs and red-brown earth. Small, primitive insects are visible crawling through the green scales.
visual_logic.background: The massive, scaly trunks of Tōtara and Rimu trees rising into the mist.
visual_logic.lighting: Speckled sunlight breaking through the high canopy, hitting the yellow spore-tips.
